_doc: Manual additions for scripts/emphasis/bold_terms.mjs and scripts/emphasis/emphasis.mjs. Mined from canonical (items, skills, personas, enemies, arcana, social-link and dungeon names); 'characters'/'locations' extend that dictionary; 'deny' removes names that are too generic; 'ambiguous' names are English words and are skipped at sentence start (arcana names are always ambiguous). 'numbered' names also match an optional ' No. <digits>' suffix. 'italic_deny' lists quoted text (exact text between the quotes) that is NOT speech and must stay upright.
